authorization: User approved statistical consistency and GRPO/GiGPO each4 rounds,4 fixed tasks x4 trajectories
engineering_admission: R9 full real batch pre/post gates and actual checkpoint restore; R10 fixed-token cross-GPU/batch scoring plus eager numerical/memory probe. Not the original CTHA checklist.
evaluation: Greedy on the same4 TRAIN tasks before and after, one each. Descriptive, no heldout/generalization or statistical efficacy claim.
initialization: Each arm starts from identical original Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, never an engineering checkpoint. Explicit Python/NumPy/Torch seed0 before native HF/PEFT construction; compare initial trainable hashes across arms.

frozen_configuration.correction: Actual sampler denominator exactly once, bypass PPO clip; no second IS/TIS/rejection

blocking_gates.checkpoint: Actual native serialization, weights/moments/step hashes; final restore required

diagnostics: per-task sampled and greedy training success
execution: GPU0 GRPO and GPU1 GiGPO independently, only overlap when actual host memory permits. This host has62GiB RAM; serialize arms if needed. No added tasks/rounds to fill cards.
checkpoints: Final native model/LoRA/AdamW binaries stay on server; publish paths and SHA256, no binaries in ordinary Git
reporting: Engineering admission is separate from learning. Four-task learning observations cannot establish generalization or CTHA efficacy. No historical failure is reclassified.
CTHA: NOT_ENABLED; only consider a separate protocol after basic baseline learning is observed
budget_changes: No extra online rounds, formal P1/P2, Tune or CTHA training
